evidence.detail: matchups() controller loads all archetypes, all people, and all cards unconditionally on every request; results and matches have no limit or pagination
self.decks and self.matches are assigned from MatchupResults without any paging
template iterates {{#show_decks}}…{{> decktable}} and {{#show_matches}}…{{> personmatches}} with no pagination controls
